scripts.dev: npm run build:iso && npm run build:countries && webpack --mode development --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:iso && npm run build:countries && webpack --mode production
scripts.build-typings: npm run clean-typings && ([ -e src/@types ] && cp -r src/@types dist-typings/@types || true) && tsc && npm run post-build-typings
scripts.post-build-typings: find dist-typings -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 sed -i.bak 's,../src/@types,@types,g' && find dist-typings -type f -name '*.d.ts.bak' -delete
